title: Fed Expected to Keep Raising Rates Until Inflation Cools
title_cn: 美联储预计将继续加息直至通胀降温
summary: Kelsey Berro, Fixed Income Portfolio Manager at JPMorgan Asset Management, discussed the Federal Reserve's challenging position amid recent disinflationary signals. Despite expectations for a modest 0.2% month-over-month increase in core CPI and relatively moderate inflation rates over several time horizons, the Fed remains cautious due to core PCE inflation running above 3%. Berro emphasized that a single data point will not dictate the Fed's next move, especially with key economic reports such as CPI, PPI, and payrolls scheduled in the coming weeks, alongside the upcoming Jackson Hole symposium. The market continues to price in potential rate hikes, reflecting the Fed's possible strategy of implementing 'insurance hikes' if inflation data remains elevated and the labor market stable. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Unpriced Food Inflation Threatens Volatile Bond Market
title_cn: 无价食品通胀威胁波动的债券市场
summary: Marie-Anne Allier, Fixed Income Fund Manager at Carmignac Gestion, discussed the current challenges facing bond markets amid rising energy prices and geopolitical tensions involving Iran. She noted that much of the negative impact from higher oil, gas, and energy prices is already priced into the market, with expectations of fewer interest rate cuts and potential hikes in the US and Europe. However, Allier highlighted a looming risk that is not yet fully reflected in bond prices: food inflation. She pointed to adverse weather conditions affecting harvests, disruptions to Ukraine's grain exports due to the conflict with Russia, and the potential volatility from El Niño as factors likely to trigger a new supply shock in food prices within the next six to twelve months. (Source: Bloomberg)

summary: President Donald Trump said he would examine whether the federal government can stop New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani’s new pied-à-terre tax, which was temporarily blocked by a state court.

title: Trump Rhetoric Leaves Hormuz Deal in Limbo
title_cn: 特朗普的言论使霍尔木兹协议陷入困境
summary:
Pakistan’s defense minister said the US and Iran are “close to some sort of arrangement” over the Strait of Hormuz, even after both sides appeared to harden their positions in the long-deadlocked negotiations.
Gautam Mukunda, Lecturer at Yale University and BBG Opinion columnist, discusses how Trump's recent rhetoric has dented Hormuz deal hopes and how it's impacting the Republican party as primaries continue across the country. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Burnham Fast-Tracks Prison Plan Over Cop-Killing Case Uproar
title_cn: 伯纳姆因枪杀警察案引起轩然大波，加快监狱计划
summary: Prime Minister Andy Burnham promised to speed up efforts to create more prison places as he attempted to quell an uproar over an inmate release plan that’s threatening to consume his crucial first weeks in office.

title: India Warns Border Strains Could Weigh on China Relations
title_cn: 印度警告边境紧张可能影响中国关系
summary: India considers incidents along its disputed border with China “most serious” and “the state of the border affairs” will “reflect on the state of our larger bilateral ties,” the Ministry of External Affairs said in response to a question about a fresh military face-off.

title: White House Lifts Ban on TikTok From US Government Devices
title_cn: 白宫解除对 TikTok 在美国政府设备上的禁令
summary: The Trump administration has lifted restrictions on the use of TikTok on federal government devices, after finding that the popular social media app no longer poses a national security threat following the shift of its US operations to American investors.

title: Hungary Elects Baka as New President in Shift From Orban Era
title_cn: 匈牙利选举巴卡为新总统，摆脱欧尔班时代
summary: Hungarian lawmakers elected former Supreme Court Justice Andras Baka as the country’s new president, in a key step toward dismantling the political legacy of former Premier Viktor Orban.

title: Russia Sees Syria Bases Deal Securing Hub for Africa Operations
title_cn: 俄罗斯认为叙利亚基地交易将确保非洲行动中心的安全
summary: The Kremlin is confident it has secured Russia’s presence at two key military bases in Syria, allowing it to project strategic influence far beyond the region, under a deal agreed with the Middle Eastern country’s new leadership.
